edits.old:
Adding a ring parameter to
`CarrierSpec` would re-sign every `v0.2.0` terminal for no gain in binding force — because the
binding is done by the `equivariant` field below, which ties the arithmetic operators to the
spec's own action and closes the bolt-on hole.
edits.new:
Adding a ring parameter to `CarrierSpec` would re-sign every `v0.2.0` terminal; instead the `equivariant` field below
ties the arithmetic operators to the spec's own action along `link` — a tie that binds only as far as `link` is
non-trivial, since `link` is not required to be injective and `link = 0` satisfies it.

edits.old:
`R` is the candidate's arithmetic structure; `ψ` its prime-indexed operators; `link` and
`equivariant` tie those operators to the specification's own action, so a candidate **cannot
satisfy this field by bolting an unrelated ring onto itself** — the hole the `finPart` defect
left open at `components_faithful` is closed here at the point of writing rather than found by a
later grading.
edits.new:
`R` is the candidate's arithmetic structure; `ψ` its prime-indexed operators; `link` and `equivariant` require the
specification's action to intertwine with `ψ` along `link` — which excludes a bolted-on ring only when `link` is
required to be non-trivial, and this structure does not require it (`link = 0` satisfies `equivariant`).

edits.old: the arithmetic structure sits inside the class object
edits.new: an additive map from the arithmetic structure into the class object (not required to be injective)

edits.old:
**A candidate satisfying `arch_present` can still be archimedean-free in substance.**  The
witness is any candidate whose archimedean map factors as above: `arch_present` holds, and yet
by `archPart_separates_nothing_new` the archimedean place contributes no information the finite
places did not already carry.  DERIVES.
edits.new:
**At `v0.1.0` a candidate satisfying `arch_present` could still be archimedean-free in substance**: for a candidate
whose archimedean map factors as above, `arch_present` holds and the archimedean place adds nothing.  Since `v0.2.0` `CarrierSpec` carries `arch_independent`, which contradicts the factoring, so this statement is vacuous
for every current candidate.

edits.old:
The specification's fields are jointly satisfiable, so no theorem stated
against `CarrierSpec` is vacuously true.
edits.new:
The specification's fields are jointly satisfiable (at `ℤ × ℝ`), so a theorem whose only hypothesis is a `CarrierSpec`
there is not vacuously true; a theorem adding a hypothesis that contradicts a field (as a factoring `φ` contradicts
`arch_independent`) still can be.

edits.old:
`Definite`, `Nondegenerate`, `SeesTheZeros` are defined as *predicates on candidates*, never as
requirements of the structure.
edits.new:
`Definite` and `Nondegenerate` are defined as *predicates on candidates*, and `SeesTheZeros` enters only as an opaque
`Prop` supplied to `ResolvesGenusTension` — none of the three is a requirement of the structure.

edits.old:
This single field is
  what excludes the entire characteristic-one / tropical class (see `no_idempotent_candidate`).
edits.new:
This field collapses every characteristic-one / tropical candidate to the zero object
  (`trivial_of_idempotent_of_spec`), and with `(R3d)` excludes the class (`no_idempotent_candidate`).
